latePickup.compensatedBody: The previous trip returned late, so the system extended your rental by {{hours}} hours (value {{amount}}). New return time: {{date}}.
latePickup.offerBody: The vehicle's previous trip may return late, which could affect your pickup time. You can accept the wait — the system will extend your rental by exactly the number of hours late, funded by the previous trip's late-return fee. If the vehicle is still not ready by your pickup time, you can cancel free of charge with a 100% deposit refund.

returnProgress.title: Return progress
returnProgress.stepConfirm: Renter confirms the record and returns the vehicle
returnProgress.completedWithOutstanding: The handover is complete; some surcharges still need to be paid below.
returnProgress.completed: Both parties have completed the vehicle handover.
returnProgress.confirmedOwner: The renter confirmed the return. Check the surcharge payment and tap Confirm vehicle received to complete the trip.
returnProgress.confirmedCustomer: You confirmed the return. Pay any remaining surcharges, then wait for the owner to confirm receipt. You do not need to tap return again.
returnProgress.reportOwner: Waiting for the renter to agree with the return record. Surcharges are only paid after this step.
returnProgress.reportCustomer: Review the record, confirm the handover and choose how to pay surcharges. If you disagree, open a dispute.
returnProgress.noReportOwner: The renter reported the handover. Inspect the vehicle and create the return record.
returnProgress.noReportCustomer: Handover reported. Wait for the owner to create the record so you can review and confirm it.

outstanding.subtitle: Applies only to surcharges incurred on return
outstanding.externalPending: Direct payment selected: {{amount}}, awaiting the owner's confirmation of full receipt. No wallet deduction for this amount.
outstanding.walletHint: The renter pays via the MoveVN wallet or directly to the owner.
outstanding.topUpHint: If your wallet balance is short, open the MoveVN wallet, top up and pay the remaining amount.
outstanding.nextStepOwner: Confirming receipt only records the payment. After inspecting the vehicle, tap Confirm vehicle received to complete the trip.
outstanding.nextStepCustomer: You confirmed the return. After paying the surcharges, wait for the owner to confirm receipt; you do not need to confirm the return again.
